test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The judge found the prisoner guilty.

options.text: The prisoner has been found guilty by the judge
The prisoner had been found guilty by the judge.
The prisoner was found guilty by the judge.
The judge was found guilty by the prisoner.

solution:
The correct answer is **'The prisoner was found guilty by the judge'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'The judge'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'the prisoner'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'found' will be changed into 'was found'. 

 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *The prisoner was found guilty by the judge.*
